Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer's order including their name and selected drinks.

customerName.description: The name of the customer who placed the order.

items.description: An array of items in the order.

createdAt.description: The time the order was submitted.

status.description: 'archived' is legacy — it predates sessions and is no longer written.

sessionId.description: The session this order belongs to, or null if placed while none was running. Always present so `sessionId == null` queries can find orphans.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: One pop-up service. Starting a session resets the drink counter; ending it freezes the session's stats onto this document.

location.description: The venue for this session (e.g. Library 2nd floor), distinct from the cafe's branch label.

startsAt.description: When the session starts. Autofilled to now but editable, so a session can be planned ahead.

drinkCount.description: Drinks made, frozen when the session ends.

orderCount.description: Completed orders, frozen when the session ends.

backfilled.description: True for sessions reconstructed from pre-sessions order history.

OrderItem.title: Order Item
OrderItem.description: Represents a single item within an order, including selected modifications.

id.description: The ID of the base drink from the menu.

modifications.description: An array of selected modification names for this item.

Drink.title: Drink
Drink.description: Represents a drink available on the menu.

name.description: The name of the drink (e.g., Maple Matcha Latte).

description.description: A short description of the drink.

category.description: The category of the drink (e.g., Lattes).

inStock.description: Indicates whether the drink is currently in stock.

order.description: The display order of the drink.

modifications.description: An array of available modification options for this drink.

Modification.title: Modification
Modification.description: Represents a single modification option for a drink.

id.description: A unique identifier for the modification.

name.description: The display name of the modification (e.g., Oat Milk).

default.description: Indicates if the modification should be enabled by default.

name.description: The name of the category (e.g., Lattes).

/cafes/{cafeId}/orders/{orderId}.description: Stores customer orders submitted through the app. Written only by the /api/orders server route.

/cafes/{cafeId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores each pop-up service and its frozen stats.
